securityScan.criticalOrHighResponse: triage within one business day and patch or mitigate immediately
securityScan.moderateResponse: triage within five business days and resolve in the next available update window
securityScan.lowResponse: record and resolve in the next monthly maintenance window

updateCadence.security: out-of-band as soon as triage and compatibility evidence are complete
updateCadence.toolchain: monthly grouped review, with TypeScript/Oxlint/Oxfmt/Vite compatibility checked as one tuple
updateCadence.runtimeAndPeer: monthly review; one compatibility-focused pull request per range change
updateCadence.asset: before every asset release and at least quarterly while an asset is supported

rules: Change package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml in the same reviewed change
Generate lockfile changes with pnpm; never hand-edit resolved versions or integrity values
CI and release checks use pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
Every registry resolution must retain an integrity value
Git, file, and unreviewed URL dependencies require explicit maintainer approval

compatibilityEvidence: React 18.2 and React 19 declaration/consumer fixtures when a peer range or React version changes

review.routine: one maintainer reviews the diff, lockfile, provenance, license result, vulnerability result, and compatibility evidence
review.securityOrLicense: the repository maintainer reviews reachability, severity, license obligations, and expiration before merge
review.majorOrAsset: the project owner and a second maintainer review compatibility, asset manifest, and publication impact
review.automation: automation may open bounded update proposals but may not merge, publish, or alter source, policy, or exception records without review

automationBounds.dependencyUpdateToolSelection: requires a separately reviewed repository configuration

rules: Production and distributed dependencies require an SPDX-identifiable license before merge
Unknown or non-allowlisted licenses fail the automated check unless a current exception names the exact package, version, license, reviewer, reason, and expiry
A development-only exception does not authorize the same license in a published artifact
License text and notices must remain available for every distributed dependency
Critical and high production advisories block publication and merge
Moderate production advisories block merge until fixed or explicitly mitigated
High and critical development advisories block merge; lower development advisories require a tracked remediation decision
An exception must be time-bounded, scoped to an advisory and package version, include reachability/false-positive evidence, a reviewer, mitigation, and an owner
Exceptions are never recorded by suppressing or deleting lockfile entries
falsePositiveReview: Confirm the advisory ID, affected version, dependency path, and installed artifact
Check whether the vulnerable code is reachable in this package and whether a fixed release exists
Record evidence and compensating controls in the exception entry; obtain maintainer review
Recheck every scheduled scan and close the exception when the dependency or advisory is resolved

actions.name: actions/setup-node
actions.purpose: exact Node.js runtime and bounded pnpm cache

rules: GitHub Actions must use a full 40-character commit SHA, with the human-readable release recorded in policy
New actions require maintainer review of source, permissions, provenance, and maintenance activity
Action updates are grouped in the monthly maintenance window or handled out-of-band for security fixes
Untrusted pull requests receive no publication or deploy credentials
The lockfile is the integrity source for npm inputs; frozen installation and registry signatures are required

publication.authority: Release Decision-6 and its protected release workflow
publication.provenance: npm trusted publishing/OIDC is preferred and must emit registry provenance for supported packages

permissions.releaseWrite: limited to the protected release step and exact tag/release identity

credentials.normal: no long-lived npm token; use environment-protected OIDC trusted publishing
credentials.emergency: a granular package-scoped token is injected only for the publish step, never logged or committed, and revoked/rotated immediately after use
credentials.rotation: review every 90 days and immediately on maintainer, provider, workflow, or suspected exposure changes
credentials.untrustedCode: fork and pull-request code cannot access publication credentials

verification: Match package set, version, tag, merge SHA, and release manifest before publication
Inspect registry version, tarball digest, and provenance after publication
Leave a mismatched or partial publication as a draft and stop for maintainer recovery
